notes: Factory default slave address: 1F (hex) = 31 (dec), set via parameter H5-01.
Broadcast address 00 is write-only; no response is returned.
Register addresses: use the Yaskawa MEMOBUS register number directly as the PDU address. No offset is applied.
Example: command register is MEMOBUS register 0001 → PDU address 0x0001.
Frequency reference and monitor values are in units of 0.01 Hz (e.g. 6000 = 60.00 Hz).
All multi-byte values in the PDU are big-endian (high byte first), per standard Modbus RTU.
CRC is CRC-16/IBM (polynomial 0x8005 reflected = 0xA001), initialised to 0xFFFF, appended little-endian (low byte first on wire).
The A1000 uses standard Modbus RTU framing. There is no 0x4000 address offset on the A1000; that scheme applies to some older Yaskawa drives (e.g. G7/P7) only.
b1-01 must be set to 2 (Modbus) for frequency reference commands to take effect.
b1-02 must be set to 2 (Modbus) for run/stop/direction commands to take effect.

H5-01.name: Drive Slave Address
H5-01.note: Set to match the master's configured slave address.

H5-06.name: Drive Transmit Wait Time
H5-06.note: Delay between receiving a request and sending the response. Master must wait at least this long after asserting DE before expecting a response.

required_parameter_setup.description: These parameters must be set on the A1000 before Modbus control is active.

01.name: Read Coil Status
01.description: Read coil (discrete output) ON/OFF status. Returns 1 bit per coil.

02.name: Read Input Status
02.description: Read discrete input status. Returns 1 bit per input.

03.name: Read Holding Registers
03.description: Read one or more 16-bit holding registers. Used for monitors and parameters. Response: [slave][03][byte_count][data HI][data LO]...[CRC_LO][CRC_HI].

06.name: Write Single Register
06.description: Write a single 16-bit holding register. Used for command word, frequency reference, or a single parameter. Drive echoes the request unchanged on success.

08.name: Loopback Test
08.description: Diagnostics loopback. Sub-function 0x0000 echoes the data word back unchanged.

10.name: Write Multiple Registers (FC 16)
10.description: Write multiple consecutive 16-bit holding registers in one message. Useful for writing command word and frequency reference simultaneously.

function_codes.note: Read functions (01, 02, 03) cannot use broadcast address 00. Write functions (06, 10) may use address 00 with no response returned.

command_registers.description: Write these registers to control the drive. b1-01 and b1-02 must both be set to 2 (Modbus).

0001.name: Command Register (MEMOBUS Command Word)
0001.description: Primary drive control word. Write to command run, stop, direction, and fault reset.

0.name: Forward Run
0.description: 1 = Run forward. Bit 1 must be 0 when this bit is set.

1.name: Reverse Run
1.description: 1 = Run reverse. Bit 0 must be 0 when this bit is set.

3.name: Fault Reset
3.description: 1 = Reset active fault (rising edge triggers reset; clear to 0 after reset).

4.name: Multi-step Ref Bit 0
4.description: Speed reference selection bit 0 (used when d1 multi-step speed is configured).

8.name: Baseblock (N.O.)
8.description: 1 = Baseblock output (output transistors off, motor coasts).

9.name: Torque Reference
9.description: 1 = Switch to torque reference (OLV/CLV modes only).

13.name: Drive Enable
13.description: 1 = Drive enabled (only relevant when drive-enable input function is configured).

0002.name: Frequency Reference
0002.description: Speed/frequency setpoint. Effective only when b1-01 = 2 (Modbus).

0003.name: PID Feedback Reference (via Modbus)
0003.description: PID feedback setpoint when Modbus is selected as PID feedback source.

status_registers.description: Read-only registers reporting drive state. Use FC 03 to read.

1.name: Zero Speed
1.description: 1 = Output frequency is at or below zero-speed level.

2.name: Reverse Running
2.description: 1 = Drive is running in reverse direction.

4.name: Speed Agree
4.description: 1 = Output frequency matches frequency reference (within agree width).

5.name: Drive Ready
5.description: 1 = Drive is ready to run (no fault, not in baseblock).

0021.name: Fault Code
0021.description: Active fault code. 0x00 = no fault. See fault_codes section for all values.

0022.name: Alarm Code
0022.description: Active alarm (minor fault) code. 0x00 = no alarm.

monitor_registers.description: Read-only monitor values. Use FC 03 to read.

0025.name: Output Frequency
0025.description: Actual output frequency to motor. 6000 = 60.00 Hz.

002C.name: Torque Reference / Estimated Torque
002C.description: Torque reference or estimated torque as percentage of rated motor torque.

002D.name: Frequency Reference Monitor
002D.description: Active frequency reference from whatever source is selected.

0042.name: kWh Monitor (High Word)
0042.description: Cumulative energy, high 16-bit word. Full value = (0042 << 16) | 0041.

parameter_registers.description: Drive parameters accessed via holding registers. Use FC 03 to read, FC 06 or FC 10 to write. Writing parameters while running may be restricted depending on the parameter.

0325.name: TX Wait Time
0325.description: 5–65 ms. Master must wait at least this long after DE goes low before expecting the response.

exception_responses.description: If the drive cannot process a request it responds with the function code OR'd with 0x80, followed by an exception code and CRC.
exception_responses.example: 01 83 02 C0 F1 = slave 01, FC 03 error, exception 02 (illegal data address)

01.name: Illegal Function
01.description: The function code is not supported.

02.name: Illegal Data Address
02.description: The register address is out of range or does not exist.

03.name: Illegal Data Value
03.description: The data value is outside the parameter's allowable range.

04.name: Slave Device Failure
04.description: Drive could not execute the request due to an internal error.

05.name: Acknowledge
05.description: Drive accepted the command but processing will take time; poll for completion.

06.name: Slave Device Busy
06.description: Drive is busy processing a previous command.

example_messages.description: Complete raw Modbus RTU byte sequences with correct CRC-16/IBM values. Format: [slave][FC][...data...][CRC_LO][CRC_HI]. All CRC values verified.

read_status_register.response_note: XX XX = 16-bit status word, high byte first. Example: 00 21 = bits 0 and 5 set (Running + Ready).

read_status_and_fault.description: Read both status (0x0020) and fault code (0x0021) in one request from slave 01
read_status_and_fault.response_note: XX XX = status word, YY YY = fault code. 4 data bytes total.

read_output_frequency.description: Read actual output frequency (0x0025) from slave 01

read_multiple_monitors.description: Read 6 monitor registers starting at 0x0025 (output freq, current, voltage, DC bus, reserved, power) from slave 01

set_frequency_60hz.description: Set frequency reference to 60.00 Hz (6000 = 0x1770) on slave 01
set_frequency_60hz.response_note: FC 06 success: drive echoes the full request unchanged.

run_forward.description: Run forward (command word bit 0 = 1) on slave 01

run_reverse.description: Run reverse (command word bit 1 = 1, bit 0 must be 0) on slave 01

stop.description: Stop (command word all zeros) on slave 01

fault_reset.description: Reset active fault on slave 01. Step 1: set bit 3 (rising edge). Step 2: clear to 0.
fault_reset.note: Wait at least 50 ms between step 1 and step 2.

run_forward_and_set_freq_together.description: Write command word (run forward) and frequency reference (60.00 Hz) in one FC 10 transaction on slave 01
run_forward_and_set_freq_together.response_note: FC 10 success response echoes start address (00 01) and register count (00 02).

loopback_test.description: FC 08 loopback diagnostic (sub-function 0x0000) to slave 01. Drive echoes the two data bytes unchanged.

fault_codes.description: Values returned in register 0x0021 when the drive has tripped. 0x00 = no fault.

codes.0C: EF0 — External fault (Modbus command word bit 2)
codes.1E: SC  — Output short circuit / ground fault
